author: Chompy_deluxe1
quote: Visually the game is obviously above average and the level of detail is probably the most complex ever. But the performance is horrific, the frame rate is low, and the input latency is the worst I’ve ever played, causing eye strain etc. Story wise, I’ve givin up after 6 hour hours of terrible pacing, odd restrictions, bland characters and little to no action. People complain about the relationship and house maintenance stuff, which is completely out of place for a gta game, but the bar stuff after Lucia gets out is what really makes it clear it’s not an actual GTA game, all gameplay just grinds to a halt and it’s just a life sim where you have to dance, make small talk, feel a baby, it’s a complete lack of respect for your time. Having played all gta games with the exception of the 1st one, this is the greatest disappointment I’ve ever had for any game, and rockstar purposely hid how crap this game was, knowing the reaction it would cause for a large cohort of people.
